about: How a ship may be dressed at the Harbourmaster's: its hull's paint, the stripe along its gunports, its canvas and its flag, each bought once and kept for every ship the player owns, its wire number its place here. A part's start entry is every player's and dresses it as built (colour null). A canvas may lay its ink on alternate cloths; a flag's device is drawn in its ink over its colour, and the flag "emblem" bears the emblem the player wears. bible/02-Systems/Shipyard.md says how each is had and drawn.

dress.name: Bare Timber
dress.words: Oiled planking, as the yard built it.

dress.name: Tar Black
dress.words: Pine tar, laid thick. Keeps the worm out.

dress.name: Harbour Blue
dress.words: The blue Overlook paints its own.

dress.name: Oxblood
dress.words: A deep red that hides a scorch.

dress.name: Kelp
dress.words: Green as the shallows off Saltmere.

dress.name: Bone
dress.words: Pale enough to be seen at night. Some want that.

dress.name: Ochre
dress.words: Earth from the hills, boiled into the paint.

dress.name: Slate
dress.words: The colour of the sea before weather.

dress.name: Lacquer Crimson
dress.words: Seven coats, rubbed down between each.

dress.name: Deep Violet
dress.words: Nobody in the yard will say what goes into it.

dress.name: Unbanded
dress.words: No band along the ports.

dress.name: White Band
dress.words: A clean line along the gunports.

dress.name: Black Band
dress.words: Makes the ports look shut, from far off.

dress.name: Red Band
dress.words: Old navies painted the gun deck red. Nobody remembers why.

dress.name: Overlook Band
dress.words: The band Overlook's own ships wear.

dress.name: Yellow Band
dress.words: Bright enough to count the guns by.

dress.name: Green Band
dress.words: A wet green, like weed at the waterline.

dress.name: Gold Leaf
dress.words: Real leaf, laid by hand. It will not last. That is the point.

dress.name: Plain Canvas
dress.words: Sailcloth as it comes off the loom.

dress.name: Bleached
dress.words: Washed white and dried in the sun.

dress.name: Tanbark
dress.words: Soaked in bark to keep the rot off.

dress.name: Red Ochre
dress.words: Fishermen's sails, the colour of rust.

dress.name: Deep Blue
dress.words: Hard to see against the water. Easy against the sky.

dress.name: Kelp Canvas
dress.words: Dyed in the green of the shallows.

dress.name: Night Canvas
dress.words: Black sails. Make of that what you will.

dress.name: Harbour Cloths
dress.words: White and blue cloths sewn turn about.

dress.name: Sunset Cloths
dress.words: Orange and red, turn about, like the sky over Saltmere.

dress.name: Storm Canvas
dress.words: Reach the Stormcallers' second rank.

dress.name: Lamp Canvas
dress.words: Reach the Lamplighters' second rank.

dress.name: Veiled Canvas
dress.words: Reach the Veiled's second rank.

dress.name: Overlook Blue
dress.words: Overlook's plain blue.

dress.name: Harbour Cross
dress.words: A white cross on Overlook's blue.

dress.name: Red Saltire
dress.words: Seen a long way off, which is the idea.

dress.name: Barred
dress.words: Black, with a white bar across it.

dress.name: Quartered
dress.words: Green and white, in four.

dress.name: Gilt Border
dress.words: Blue, edged in gold thread.

dress.name: Pole Star
dress.words: One star, for whoever steers by it.

dress.name: Your Emblem
dress.words: Flies the emblem you wear, whichever it is.

dress.name: Anchor

dress.name: Gull
dress.words: A white gull on a sky.
